name: mastery-learning
description: A local-first tutoring plugin for Codex with guided HTML lessons, practice, projects, and review.

interface.shortDescription: Guided lessons, hands-on practice, and local progress.
interface.longDescription: Tell Mastery Learning what you want to learn and how much time you have. It plans a route, opens each teaching turn in a local HTML classroom, prepares exercises and interactive labs, checks independent work and later recall, and resumes from learner-owned progress in a new Codex task.
defaultPrompt: Help me learn this topic from my current level.
Continue from my saved progress and start with anything due for review.
Turn this concept into a guided lesson with a hands-on exercise.
